correctness.rationale: The eight equal-edge vertices yield two caps and eight exact triangular facet normals; explicit incidence signs prove the complete five-interval partition on a symmetry sector. Haar spherical density dφdw/(1+w²)^(3/2) integrates with F(w)=w/sqrt(1+w²) and a single arcsine antiderivative to the four displayed probabilities, all positive and summing to one. The standalone checker independently recovers ten facets, compares 20,000 direct projected 2D convex hulls, matches quadrature within 8e-11 and matches the 16-edge dihedral mean. Exceptional normals have measure zero.

value.rationale: A full joint shadow-type law for a canonical convex uniform eight-vertex solid is a natural exact stochastic invariant beyond the known mean. It identifies all four generic outcome types (including rare heptagons), supplies explicit radical arcsine probabilities, and gives an independent dihedral-angle consistency check for geometric projection algorithms. It is neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor a substitution of a preexisting expectation formula.
